# Antiemetics


Antiemetic drugs can be classified by their mechanism of action:

* Serotonin antagonists
    * Ondansetron
* Corticosteroids
    * Dexamethasone\
    Has additional effects on postsurgical pain and fatigue.
* Dopamine antagonists
    * Phenothiazines
        * Chlorpromazine
        * Prochlorperazine
    * Butyrophenones
        * Droperidol
    * Benzamides
        * Metoclopramide
* Anticholinergics
    * Hyoscine
    * Atropine
* Antihistamines
    * Cyclizine
* NK~1~ antagonists
    * Aprepitant
* Others
    * Benzodiazepines
    * Cannabinoids
    * Propofol
